text: West Plains native Stan Utley was inducted into the Missouri Golf Hall of Fame on Oct. 26, honoring his career as a professional golfer, instructor and junior golf advocate. Well played, West Plains.
Missouri Independent reporter Rudi Keller tracks which PACs are spending the most in Missouri's midterm election push. Follow the money, as the saying goes.
MoDOT has picked specific rural interstate segments in Missouri for a 75 mph speed limit under a new state law. Lead feet, rejoice.

Missouri State Board of Education members are split over giving every public school and district an A-through-F grade, with one member saying people respond better to inspiration than threats. Nobody likes a pop quiz.
Missouri Interim Education Commissioner Stacey Preis resigned on Oct. 20, effective immediately, as the state board searches for a permanent leader. Another chair opens up.
The Chiefs improved to 5-0 with a 22-6 win over the Chargers on Oct. 19, and Patrick Mahomes threw for 272 yards to earn his 100th career win. Chiefs Kingdom is smiling.
No. 13 Missouri lost 31-3 at No. 9 Ole Miss on Oct. 18, with Austin Simmons throwing for 339 yards but the Tigers scoring only a field goal. Time for the Tigers to shake it off.
